dialogue.origin: 本日はよろしくお願いします。時間になりましたら始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming today. We'll begin now that it's time.

dialogue.origin: (こちらこそお世話になります。よろしくお願い致します。)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for having me. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。はじめに年齢、性別、本日の相談内容をお聞かせください。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 16歳、男、学校辞めたい
dialogue.content: 16, male, I want to quit school.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。高校を辞めたいということですね？いつ頃からそう思うようになったのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. You want to quit high school, is that right? When did you start feeling that way?

dialogue.origin: 半年くらい前
dialogue.content: About six months ago.

dialogue.origin: ということは入学して割とすぐにそう思ったのですね？何がきっかけがあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So that means you felt that way fairly soon after starting school? Was there something that triggered it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 友達がいないから
dialogue.content: Because I don't have any friends.

dialogue.origin: 勉強もつまんない
dialogue.content: Studying is boring too.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。友達がいなくて勉強も面白くないのですね。中学からのお友達や顔見知りも全くいないのですか？
dialogue.content: I understand. You don't have friends, and studying isn't interesting. Are there no friends or acquaintances from middle school at all?

dialogue.origin: いない
dialogue.content: None.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。それは不安ですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must make you feel anxious.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どういう時に一番辛いと感じますか？
dialogue.content: When do you feel the worst?

dialogue.origin: 休み時間1人でいる時
dialogue.content: When I'm alone during breaks.

dialogue.origin: 休み時間の時が辛いのですね。その時、どういうことを考えますか？
dialogue.content: Break times are tough for you. What kinds of thoughts do you have then?

dialogue.origin: 早く帰りたい
dialogue.content: I want to go home soon.

dialogue.origin: って思う
dialogue.content: That's what I think.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。そう思っちゃいますよね。
dialogue.content: That makes sense. It’s natural to feel that way.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 他の時間はどうですか？
dialogue.content: How about other times?

dialogue.origin: 普通
dialogue.content: They're okay.

dialogue.origin: でも体育は嫌い
dialogue.content: But I hate PE.

dialogue.origin: 座ってやる授業は大丈夫ということかな？体育は運動が苦手だから嫌いなの？
dialogue.content: So seated classes are okay? Do you dislike PE because you’re not good at sports?

dialogue.origin: 勉強はつまんない体育は他の人と一緒にやるから嫌い
dialogue.content: Studying is boring. I hate PE because you have to do it with other people.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。勉強はどういうところが嫌い？
dialogue.content: I see. What is it about studying that you dislike?

dialogue.origin: つまんない
dialogue.content: It's boring.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。体育は他の人とやるから嫌いとのことだけど何か具体的に嫌な思いをしたことがあるのかな？
dialogue.content: I understand. You said you dislike PE because it’s with others—have you had any specific unpleasant experiences?

dialogue.origin: 友達いないから
dialogue.content: Because I don't have friends.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。友達がいないと確かにつまらないよね。誰かと喋りたいよね。
dialogue.content: I see. It's true that it's no fun without friends. You want to talk to someone, don't you?

dialogue.origin: わかんない友達いないとダメ？
dialogue.content: I don't know... Is it bad to not have friends?

dialogue.origin: ダメじゃないと思うよ。一人が好きって人もたくさんいるよ。
dialogue.content: I don't think it's bad at all. There are many people who prefer to be alone.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ
dialogue.content: Oh, really?

dialogue.origin: そうだと思うよ。
dialogue.content: Yes, I think so.

dialogue.origin: でも学校に友達がいたらいいなと思うのかな？
dialogue.content: But do you wish you had friends at school?

dialogue.origin: 1人よりはいいかも
dialogue.content: It might be better than being alone.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。でも今まで半年以上登校してたんだね。よく頑張っているね。
dialogue.content: I see. But you've been going to school for over half a year now. You've been trying really hard.

dialogue.origin: ありがとう
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: うん、本当によく頑張ってるね。これから友達が一人いればいいなとのお話だったけど、自分で何かこうしてみようかな？って思うようなことはあるのかな？もしあれば聞かせてくれないかな？
dialogue.content: Yes, you really have been. You mentioned it would be nice to have at least one friend. Is there anything you've thought of trying to do yourself? If so, would you mind sharing it with me?

dialogue.origin: わかんない
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: どうすればいい？
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: そうだね。例えば、君の周りで一人でいる子は誰か見かけたことはない？
dialogue.content: Let’s see. For example, have you noticed anyone around you who is also by themselves?

dialogue.origin: いない
dialogue.content: No one.

dialogue.origin: みんなグループになってる
dialogue.content: Everyone's in groups.

dialogue.origin: そっか。みんなお友達になっているように見えるんだね。
dialogue.content: I see. So it looks like everyone has made friends.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 部活は入っているの？
dialogue.content: Are you in any clubs?

dialogue.origin: 入っていない
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。中学の時はどうだったの？何かやってた？
dialogue.content: I see. How about in middle school? Were you in anything?

dialogue.origin: 野球部だった
dialogue.content: I was on the baseball team.

dialogue.origin: 高校では続けようと思わなかったのかな？
dialogue.content: Did you not think about continuing in high school?

dialogue.origin: 好きでやってたわけじゃないから
dialogue.content: I wasn't doing it because I liked it.

dialogue.origin: 楽しくなかった？
dialogue.content: It wasn't fun?

dialogue.origin: 楽しくない
dialogue.content: It wasn't fun.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんだ。じゃあ好きなことや、やってみたいこととか楽しいなと思うことってあるかな？
dialogue.content: I see. So, is there anything you like, want to try, or find fun?

dialogue.origin: わかんない
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: まだわからないんだね。中学の時の友達や高校以外ではどうかな？
dialogue.content: You don't know yet. How about with your friends from middle school, or outside of high school?

dialogue.origin: どうって？
dialogue.content: What do you mean?

dialogue.origin: 楽しいって思うこと、何かあるかな？好きなことってある？
dialogue.content: Is there anything you find fun? Anything you like to do?

dialogue.origin: ゲームとか
dialogue.content: Games, I guess.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。ゲームが好きなんだね。楽しいよね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you like games. They're fun, aren't they?

dialogue.origin: 楽しいかどうかはわかんない
dialogue.content: I'm not sure if they're fun.

dialogue.origin: でも遊んだりはする
dialogue.content: But I do play them.

dialogue.origin: 今一番好きなことは、強いて言えばゲームなんだね。オンラインでやったりしてるのかな？
dialogue.content: So, if you had to say, the thing you like most right now is gaming. Do you play online?

dialogue.origin: オンラインで遊んでる
dialogue.content: I play online.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。そこでは友達いるんだね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you have friends there.

dialogue.origin: 友達なのかな
dialogue.content: I wonder if they’re friends.

dialogue.origin: わかんない
dialogue.content: I’m not sure.

dialogue.origin: いろんな友達いていいと思うけどな。それに、いつも一緒にいたりする関係が友達ってわけでもないと思うけど。
dialogue.content: I think it's fine to have all kinds of friends. Besides, I don't think friends are only people you're with all the time.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: どう思う？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そうかもしない
dialogue.content: Maybe so.

dialogue.origin: しれない
dialogue.content: Perhaps.

dialogue.origin: 君はもう毎日登校してて充分頑張ってるよ。でもやっぱり友達欲しいなって思ったらもし一人でいる子を見かけた時、寒いね、とか少し声かけてみるのもいいかもしれないよ。どんなきっかけで仲良くなるかわからないから
dialogue.content: You're already trying so hard just by going to school every day. But if you do find yourself wanting a friend, maybe if you see someone else who is alone, you could try saying something small, like 'It's cold, isn't it?'. You never know what might start a friendship.

dialogue.origin: わかった
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 少し頑張ってみる
dialogue.content: I'll try a little.

dialogue.origin: きっと君なら少しずつ乗り越えられると思うな。応援してます。今日は時間になってしまったけどどうだったかな？今日は言いにくい話、話してくれてありがとう。またいつでも相談にきてね。待ってます。
dialogue.content: I'm sure you can overcome this, little by little. I'm rooting for you. Our time is up for today, but how was it for you? Thank you for sharing things that were difficult to talk about today. Please feel free to come and talk anytime. I'll be here.

dialogue.origin: 話聞いてくれてありがとう自分の話を聞いてくれる友達が欲しいなって思った
dialogue.content: Thank you for listening. It made me realize I want a friend who will listen to me.

dialogue.origin: きっと一番いいタイミングでできると思うよ。君は一人じゃないからね。いつでもきてね。
dialogue.content: I'm sure you'll be able to make one at the best possible time. You're not alone, you know. You can come here anytime.

dialogue.origin: ありがとう
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: （時間になりましたので、終了させていただきます。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (Our time is up, so we will end the session here. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.origin: (お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time. I appreciate it.)

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

topic.sub: 高校を辞めたい原因と友達のいないことによる不安
